integrity: The proof reduces worst-case descent to an exact two-eigenvalue extremal problem for a symmetric positive definite regularized normal matrix. Sharpness is realized by a source-compatible linear least-squares model. The LSMR exception is established directly from the step-residual orthogonality used in the primary source.
scientific_limitations: The frontier applies to arbitrary residual vectors constrained only by the Euclidean norm test for one regularized normal equation. Solver-specific orthogonality or other structure can permit larger forcing terms. The result does not replace the source random-embedding, Armijo, probabilistic-complexity, or local-convergence analysis.
title: Sharp forcing threshold for solver-agnostic descent in sketched Levenberg-Marquardt steps
